// === Tab: mySketch ===
let pnc;

let fragSrc = [
'precision mediump int;',
'precision mediump float;',

'vec2 res = vec2(512. , 512.);',
'uniform vec3 t;' ,
  
'float hash(float x){',
'  return fract(sin(x) * 43758.5453) * 2. - 1.;',
'}',

'vec2 hashPosition(float x){',
'  return vec2(',
'    floor(hash(x) * 3.) * 132. + 16.,',
'    floor(hash(x * 1.1) * 2.) * 32. + 16.',
'  );',
'}',

'void main(){',
'  float speed = 50.;',
'  float time = t.x / 250.;',
'  float falloff = 1.3;',

'  const int NumMetaBalls =23;',
'  vec3 metaBalls[NumMetaBalls];',

'  float d = 0.;',
'  vec2 screen;',
'  float c = 0.;',

'  for(int i = 0; i < NumMetaBalls; i++){',
'    vec2 pos = hashPosition(float(i))+',
'    vec2(time * speed * (1. + float(i)));',
'    screen = floor(mod(pos/res, vec2(2.)));',
'    vec2 dir = screen * 2. - 1.;',
'    vec2 finalPos = vec2(res * (vec2(1.) - screen) + dir * mod(pos, res));',
'    metaBalls[i] = vec3(finalPos, abs((float(i))));',
'    metaBalls[i].z = res.y / 200. * float(i) * .5;',
'    d = metaBalls[i].z / distance(metaBalls[i].xy , gl_FragCoord.xy);',
'    c += pow(d, falloff);',
'  }',
'  float c2 = (c < 1.) ? 0. : c;',
'  gl_FragColor = vec4(c2, c + .2, c, 1);',
'}'].join('');

let vert = [
'uniform mat4 transform;',
'uniform mat4 texMatrix;',
'attribute vec4 vertex;',
'attribute vec2 texCoord;',
'varying vec4 vertTexCoord;',
'void main() {',
'  gl_Position = transform * vertex;',
'  vertTexCoord =  vec4(texCoord, 1.0, 1.0);',
'}'].join('');

(function(d, script) {
    script = d.createElement('script');
    script.type = 'text/javascript';
    script.async = true;
    script.onload = function(){
      let cvs = document.getElementById('pjsCanvas');

      let p5src =
		[
		'PImage img;',  
		'PShader sh;' ,
		'void setup(){',
		'  size(512, 512, P3D);',
		'  sh = loadShader("https://openprocessing.org/sketch/417128/files/' + vert  + '","' + fragSrc + '", true);',
		'  shader(sh);',
		'}',

		'void draw(){',
		'  sh.set("t", new PVector(frameCount, frameCount, 0));',
		'  rect(0,0,width, height);',
		'}'].join('');
      
      pnc = new ProcessingNoConflict(cvs, p5src);
    };
    script.src= 'https://rawgit.com/asalga/p55hade/master/libs/test.js';
    d.getElementsByTagName('body')[0].appendChild(script);
}(document));
